condition: persistent painful fissured sores at both corners of the mouth with a smooth red burning tongue over 4 weeks despite plain lip balm
level_rationale: Four weeks of painful cracked sores at both corners of the mouth accompanied by a smooth red tongue with a burning sensation despite using plain lip balm in a 39-year-old adult points to persistent angular commissural fissuring with atrophic glossodynia warranting a non-urgent outpatient clinic visit for iron, folate, and vitamin B12 evaluation and targeted antifungal or nutritional therapy rather than emergency care, whereas mild dry chapping at both corners of the mouth for 1 day last week while using plain lip balm represents minor self-limited lip dryness needing only routine self-care.
